Designed vector database schema and indexing strategy to store embeddings for millions of docs, improving top-k retrieval precision. Exposed annotation and model endpoints via FastAPI for internal teams and automated nightly refreshes of embeddings. Worked closely in Agile sprints to iterate on metrics, A/B test model variants, and ensure low-latency responses in production.
